title: Credential compared to a literal (java) — review required
description: A credential-named value is compared to a quoted literal: (?:password|passwd|pwd)s*(?:==|.equalss*()s*["'][^"']{4,}["'. Hardcoded comparison secrets ship in source and binaries, and rotation needs a release. This lexical rule flags the comparison; the reviewer confirms it is test-only or moves the secret out.
remediation: Compare against a value from a secret manager or KDF-verified hash and rotate the exposed literal.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches literal comparisons regardless of environment. Generic secret assignments are separate rules.
